featured_reviews.name: Ranjan Gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honest Warning — Think Before You Buy Mahindra XUV700
Not even one year, and my car has broken down multiple times in the middle of the road.
This is not just an inconvenience — it is a serious safety risk. It becomes extremely dangerous, especially when you are in another city, stuck in an unknown place, and your car suddenly stops working. The situation becomes even more stressful and unsafe when you are traveling with your family.
What is even more frustrating is that it is not the same problem every time — each time, a new issue arises. The service center keeps the car for 3–4 days, which forces me to spend extra money on travel for my work. Despite this, there is no proper accountability or care shown.
I have already spent a significant amount of money on repairs, yet the problems keep coming back. This is completely unacceptable.
When we invest our hard-earned money in a car, we expect reliability, safety, and peace of mind. Unfortunately, this experience has been the opposite.
Earlier, I owned a Creta — it was smooth, reliable, and never gave me such trouble even once.
If you are planning to buy the XUV700, please be careful. You may end up wasting your money, time, and energy.
This is my honest and real experience. I sincerely hope Mahindra takes responsibility and improves its quality and service.

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Hemdev
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a pleasure to visit NBS ANDHERI SHOWROOM and have a look at the BE 6, which truly captivated my entire family. I was especially impressed by the Mahindra Electric vehicles, and the BE 6 model, in particular, stood out. Hence I made a decision to buy one. Despite engaging in several discussions with Mr. Rishiraj, a sales executive with considerable EV expertise, I was unable to confirm a guaranteed delivery of my preferred BE 6 variant and color within my desired timeframe. Furthermore, his responsiveness to my inquiries was less than satisfactory.

Consequently, I proceeded to book my vehicle with a different, reputable dealer in Thane, securing my desired color and variant within my specified timeframe, coinciding with Navratri.

During a subsequent visit to the showroom to address feature-related queries, Mr. Rishiraj, upon learning of my purchase elsewhere, expressed surprise. He then cited his lunch break as a reason for not assisting me and indicated that another staff member would be assigned. After waiting for approximately 20-25 minutes and inquiring at the reception, I observed a lack of coordination among the staff.

I understand NBS is, to my understanding, a Mahindra venture, I believe that the staff should exhibit a more professional approach when interacting with Mahindra customers visiting the showroom as we are part of Mahindra Family now.

NBS is acknowledged as a premier Mahindra dealership within the suburban area and was always my preferred choice for reserving the BE 6. However, enhancements to customer service protocols are recommended.

Nevertheless, it would be a priviledge experience to have the vehicle serviced at NBS .

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the experience I had with Modi Mahindra during the purchase and delivery of my new car. What should have been a happy experience turned into a frustrating and stressful process due to poor communication, lack of ownership, and unprofessional handling throughout.
Issues before payment:
•	An incomplete chassis number was shared, delaying the insurance process. Despite repeated follow-ups, calls often went unanswered.
•	I had to constantly remind and push the sales team for even basic tasks, with no proactive coordination from the dealership.
•	When the person handling my office documentation became unavailable, nobody informed me. I had to personally check the status.
•	Even after clearly specifying the required documents for vendor creation, incomplete documents were shared, causing further delays.
Issues after payment:
Payment was completed on 23-Apr-2026 with an assurance of delivery within 4 working days. However, there was no communication or update after payment, and I had to repeatedly follow up and escalate just to get delivery visibility. Although I requested delivery on 09-May-2026 between 10:30 AM and 12 PM, there was no response to my email and no proactive update from the dealership. Even after being promised a callback within 10 minutes, nobody called back till 4 PM.
Delivery day issues:
•	After reaching home found out that paid accessories were missing. After following up they informed that accessories was not in stock. The could have informed these things at time of delivery.  I was also asked to coordinate separately with the accessories manager, and there is still no clarity on pending items.
•	The vehicle was delivered in an unacceptable condition with dirt marks inside and even opened mouth freshener packets left in the car.
•	Despite paying around ₹1,19,000 for accessories, no demo or explanation was provided for installed items like the dashcam, including whether it was functioning, recording, or where footage is stored.
•	The FASTag sticker was missing despite charges being taken, forcing me to turn back midway while driving to office the next working day.
•	The vehicle feature demo was provided only after I insisted, and even then I was hurried because other deliveries were lined up.
•	The PUC certificate could not be found.
•	No proper explanation was provided regarding service schedule, first service timeline, maintenance, or ownership guidance.
•	Random coupons and documents were left in the glove box without any explanation.
This issue is not about delayed delivery alone — delays can happen. The real concern is the complete lack of communication, accountability, coordination, and customer care throughout the process. While there was a cake-cutting ceremony during delivery, customer experience, transparency, proper communication, delivery readiness, and professionalism are far more important than symbolic gestures after weeks of frustration and follow-ups.
Overall, this has been one of the most poorly managed customer experiences I have encountered, and I am extremely disappointed with both the dealership and the overall customer handling.
